content: Isaraele Wambunya Yulu Keyange Dupwa Uki Paleya

Mona kare kare kara nalyo. Namba akali mendeme lopapala isa dupwana jingi lyilyape lao kandelyamo lyii nao isa girapo dupwana jingi lyii nalyamo kando pingi dopale ingilyamo. Doo girapo jingipi piki jingi rende pingipi dupwa peparae lyuo otami.

Akali yulu rolae pingi mende yuu dokona kara nalyamo. Mendeme Anatu warombo serami ingya nalyamo. Nakama peparae kumuo oteyami. Wambu peparae pyao kumalena yuu gii angi mende pilyape lao isilyaminyi. Nakama pepareme yango dupwa pyalena lao koto karaminyi.

Nakama peparae yulu koo dupwana pinya ama mora piso otasi karaminyi. Akali mupwa dupwape kote singi dupwapeme yulu koo dokona panga soo nyisamana kana jinya lao nyakamyuo karaminyi. Akali andake dokome lao dokopa, Dopa pimili lao suu pilyu, lapyamo dokopa menge dupwa pipya wato lao petaminyi.

Lapo ama keyange pyuo karamano lao suu pilyaminyi dupwape dee lapo rolae wakasa pyuo karamano lao suu pilyaminyi dupwape mee kapa pali napyamo ipi pyuo pyuo karaminyi. Yuu gii Anatumi wambu dupwa randa mairu lao poropeta akali dupwa keta repe repe pii lao reteyamo doko epapelyamo. Nakama dokona apa pimwane lao suu pyao saka nalyaminyi.
Embena anda maki palenge dokope embena puu minyingi dokomepe pii langirami dupwa angi lapo langilyaminyi lao suu pyaa napipi. Dee kamame embena etene dokope kandokondali pyuo pii waso lamaipi.

Yuu gii pyaka seramo dokopa ikinyingi dupwame rakange dupwa kopyali inginyi nembo wanenge dupwame endangi dupwa kando mata rukyuo pyao enda dupwame ayangepa sisi nyuo pirami. Akali mendena ree palu mendaki dupwa banya yanda pimwaiko ingyarami.
Dopa piraminyipape nambame Kamongo kandaro kararo. Namba mona porayapala Kamongo dokome namba pyuo nyeramo doko keta isaro kararo. Nambana Anatu dokome nambana pii sera.
Kamongome Pyuo Lete Nyela Epara

Namwana yanda pimwai dupwame renge mende pali naramopa namwa kilya kando gilya giyana pyuo rae maiya nalapape. Namwa koo keta papalape dee keyange keta palirama ingilyamo. Dopako pyuo namwa dakepa iminjingi dokona karamano doko Kamongo dokome yanga paupau lenge renge jera.

Namwa Kamongo kando koo piyamano dokona banya imbu singi doko namwa keta kapa popokau laramo nyemanale. Nyeramanopa enakana baame namwa kando koo piminyi dupwa nyuo rolakao nyiso pira. Dopa pipala baame namwa yangenge dorena nyuo pisaramo namwa rangeme nyiso kyawa minyara doko kandaramako.

Dopa piramo doko kandapala dokopa nambana yanda pimwai dupwa elya nyerami. Wamba dokopa nakamame namba piso soo male male lao, Embena Kamongo Anatu doko anja karamo? leyami. Leyaminyi dupwa rengya kata dokona wara ingyuo kalyuo pyarakwuarami ingilyamo.
Jerusaleme wambu dupwa yuu taone andake dokona kana kame kamba pirami yuu gii doko epelyamo. Yuu gii dokopa nakamana yuu doko dumbili dumbili lao konda pyuo nyerami lyakande.

Yuu gii dokopa nakamana wambu yuu Asiria dulurena petaminyi dupwape yuu Isipi donorena petaminyi dupwape ipwa Yuporisa repeta petaminyi dupwape dee ipwa kota ama londeta repeta piso palyuo pao kamame yuu kyau naneta pelyaminyi wambu dupwape peparae range sukusa epo pyasarami.
Dopa piraminyipape wambu yuu dokona palaminyi dupwame yulu koo pilyaminyi dokona lao yuu doko penda penda ingyuo para.
Kamongo Dokome Isaraele Wambu Mona Rando Karapala Nyisiya

Kamongo, embena wambu yapo rombo palyuo nyiinyi dupwana emba rapu pingi akali karape. Nakama yuu muiyane dokona palyuo karaminyipape paki pakipi yuu elyape sipyamoko palaminyi. Yuu Besane yuu Giliatepe nenge singi yuu dolapona wamba piyaminyili pyuo nao palyuo karala pena lapili yaka.
Kamongo, wamba yuu Isipi doko yaki nyuo epeyamanopa yulu kanda nange yamarangwaramili lapo pii kande doko suu pyao dakepa pyakape.
Yuu muu dupwana wambu porai karamano lao suu pilyaminyi dupwame yulu doko dopa pirinyi kandapala elya nyerami. Nakama kambu upi lapala kalepoe karele larami.
Nakama rombame kata wapuo yuu dokona kau ingyuo nakamana yalu pyuo pisiraminyi panda doko yaki nyuo neta walu walu lao eparami. Nakama pakame kumuo namwana Kamongo Anatu doko keta kapu kyuo eparami.

Kamongo emba yale anatu mende kara nalyaminyi. Embena wambu mee kumapa nao lete karaminyi dusipana koo dupwa nyuo kame sakamilini. Emba mee imbuo karalu kara napala embena mona retalu reto retenge renge doko namwa keta lasaka pingi.
Embame namwa deeko kondo sakao nyiso karare. Embame namwana koo dupwa yuu dokona kalyuo minjiku minyapala kota pete yalu dokona nembare.

Embame embena yulu keyange pyakao karalu karenge dokope embena mona retalu reto retenge renge dokope dolapo embena Isaraele wambu Aporakame Jekopepena para pyasi dupwa lasaka piri. Wamba namwana rora ambasu dupwa dopa piruŋu lalu lao leeneli pyuo lasaka pirisa pira.
